# Handyeco - Edinburgh Handyman Services

> Professional 5-star rated handyman services in Edinburgh & Lothians. Specializing in flat-pack furniture assembly, TV wall mounting into Edinburgh tenement sandstone walls, silicone sealing, painting, and property maintenance.

Handyeco is a local, owner-operated property maintenance and handyman service based in Edinburgh, Scotland. Lead tradesperson Ekrem Guran provides upfront fixed pricing, guaranteed workmanship, and fast response times across all EH postcodes.

## Core Services & Website Sections

- [Handyeco Homepage](https://handyeco.co.uk/): Official website for Handyeco Edinburgh Handyman Services.
- [Handyman Services](https://handyeco.co.uk/#services): Complete catalogue of repair and assembly services including IKEA PAX assembly, TV wall mounting, silicone sealing, and door adjustments.
- [Customer Reviews](https://handyeco.co.uk/#reviews): 73+ verified 5.0-star customer reviews from Edinburgh homeowners and tenants.
- [Service Coverage Areas](https://handyeco.co.uk/#areas): Edinburgh postcodes (EH1–EH17), Musselburgh (EH21), Dalkeith (EH22), and Livingston (EH54).
- [Work Gallery](https://handyeco.co.uk/#gallery): High-resolution before and after photos of local Edinburgh jobs.
- [FAQ](https://handyeco.co.uk/#faq): Frequently asked questions about pricing, stone wall fixings, tools, and availability.
- [Get a Free Quote](https://handyeco.co.uk/#quote): Online 60-second quote form with photo upload and instant estimate request.
